name: PS2X_lib
description: LROB.RU edition. PlayStation 2 controller driver (DualShock, Guitar Hero, cheap 2.4 GHz wireless pads) for Arduino AVR and ESP32. GPLv3 derivative of the original PS2X_lib 1.9 by Bill Porter, Shutter, Eric Wetzel and Kurt Eckhardt (https://github.com/madsci1016/Arduino-PS2X): same API and drop-in replacement, plus ESP32 support (direct GPIO registers, cycle accurate timing), clear error codes, hot-plug recovery and runtime tunable bit timing.
keywords: ps2, playstation, gamepad, joystick, controller, dualshock, esp32, avr, arduino, lrob
